name: SIAI-Marchetti S.205
summary: Italian four-seat all-metal touring airplane with a sleek low-wing layout and retractable gear, built in the 1960s and 70s and found in small numbers in the US.

wings: Low, tapered cantilever wing with squared-off tips
Flaps along the inboard trailing edge
engines: Single Lycoming flat-four or flat-six with a two-blade propeller
fuselage: Long glazed cabin with a sloping windscreen and a raised roof
tail: Tall swept fin with a large rudder

tellTales: Sleek four-seat low-wing with a long glazed cabin and a tall swept fin
Retractable tricycle gear on a smooth, sporty airframe
European look: rakish windscreen and tapered wing

confusedWith.howToTell: The Arrow has a more upright cabin and a stubbier tail; the S.205 has a sleeker, more raked cabin and a taller swept fin.
The SF.260 is a tandem trainer with tip tanks; the S.205 is a four-seat tourer with a long glazed cabin.
The Mooney has a forward-swept tail and a smaller cabin; the S.205 has a tall swept fin and a larger cabin.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
